smoke_test.check: wrapper self-test (python wrapper.py) in the Legwork sandbox, network off

entrypoint: Compute readability metrics and text statistics from text using the textstat Python library
install_command:
pip install textstat==0.7.13
python -c "import nltk; nltk.download('cmudict', download_dir='./nltk_data', quiet=True, raise_on_error=True)"

arguments.text: Banana is a yellow fruit. Elephants walk slowly.

known_answer.derived_from: the text has 2 sentences and 8 words; syllables ba-na-na 3, is 1, a 1, yel-low 2, fruit 1, el-e-phants 3, walk 1, slow-ly 2 sum to 14 with two words (banana, elephants) of 3+ syllables; the letters of the 8 words sum to 39
